FAQ
What is IPO Prime?
IPO Prime is a global asset subscription platform launched by Bitget, focusing on investment opportunities in the pre-listing and initial public offering stages of companies. Eligible users can participate using supported stablecoins without opening a separate overseas brokerage account. The platform includes two sections: Pre-IPO and IPO:
Pre-IPO: Participate before the company goes public. Pre-tokens are delivered. Holding pre-tokens represents a debt instrument from the issuer to the holder, designed to reflect the company's performance;
IPO: Participate during the company's official IPO issuance stage. Settlement is based on the official issue price, and allocated assets are delivered as rTokens backed by real stocks.
What is the difference between IPO subscription on Bitget IPO Prime and traditional brokerage subscription?
IPO Prime integrates IPO subscriptions into your crypto account, offering a more convenient and flexible way to participate:
Direct participation with stablecoins: Subscribe using your Bitget account and supported stablecoins without opening a separate overseas brokerage account, reducing account opening and cross-platform fund transfer steps.
Participate with small amounts: Supports fractional share allocation, eliminating the need to prepare funds for whole shares, allowing you to flexibly arrange your investment according to your needs.
Access to institutional-grade IPO allocation channels: Connects with top global funds/family offices through a professional institutional allocation network, providing eligible investors with an institutional-grade participation path distinct from traditional retail subscription models.
Allocated assets are delivered as rTokens backed by real stocks. Once credited and open for trading, they can be held or traded directly on Bitget. Specific participation eligibility, allocation results, and delivery arrangements are subject to official announcements.
When will the final IPO issue price be confirmed?
It is usually announced after confirmation by the underwriters on the IPO pricing date. Bitget will update the project page simultaneously after obtaining the confirmation information. The specific time is subject to the confirmation progress between the issuer and the institutions. The estimated price does not constitute a final pricing commitment.
Note: When you submit your investment, the final IPO issue price may not yet be determined, so the page provides an estimated issue price for reference. The final issue price is determined by the issuer and underwriters based on subscription demand, market conditions, valuation, and other factors, and may be higher or lower than the estimated price. Bitget does not determine the final issue price, and subscriptions will be settled based on the official issue price and applicable fees.
What are the allocation rules?
Bitget will calculate the allocated amount based on the actual stock quota obtained for the corresponding project or round, according to the pre-announced allocation rules and the user's valid investment. The specific rules will be displayed on the subscription page.
Popular projects may experience oversubscription, and the invested amount does not equal the final allocated amount. Bitget does not guarantee full allocation or a fixed allocation rate.
How are unallocated funds handled?
During allocation settlement, the platform will only deduct the amount required for the actual allocation and the corresponding underwriting service fee. The remaining unused funds will be unfrozen and returned according to the rules after the allocation ends.
*Underwriting service fee: The underwriting service fee is a subscription-related service fee charged by project partner funds, brokerages, or allocation channels. The specific fee rate and calculation method will be displayed before submitting the commitment. This fee is only charged on the actual allocated portion, is already included in the committed amount, and requires no additional payment.
When will the allocation results be confirmed? When will the assets be delivered?
After the final issuance price and channel quota are determined, the platform will complete the allocation calculation and announce the users' allocation results. Allocation confirmation and asset delivery are different stages; rTokens will be distributed according to the delivery schedule announced in advance by the project. The delivery time for different projects or rounds may vary, and the actual progress may also be affected by brokerage settlement, custody, and system processing.
What are the differences between different subscription rounds for the same project? Can I participate in them simultaneously?
Eligibility, investment limits, fees, allocation rules, and delivery times may vary across different rounds. Please refer to the subscription page for details. Eligible users can participate in multiple subscription rounds simultaneously.
What risks should I be aware of when participating in an IPO subscription?
- Issuance change risk: The IPO may be delayed, suspended, or canceled due to market, regulatory, or issuance arrangements. In such cases, Bitget will process subscriptions according to the applicable product terms and release the corresponding frozen funds; specific processing methods and times are subject to the product terms and notifications.
- Allocation and delivery risk: Submitting a subscription does not guarantee an allocation or a full allocation. Asset delivery may be delayed due to issuance arrangements, settlement processes, or third-party channel processing progress, and users may be unable to trade at the expected time.
- Price and liquidity risk: The price after the IPO listing may fluctuate significantly, and may even fall below the issue price and the subscription cost including fees. The relevant assets may also experience insufficient liquidity, trading suspensions, or the inability to sell in a timely manner, and users may lose part or all of their investment principal.
- Tokenized asset risk: If tokenized stocks or other tokenized assets are delivered, their legal nature and holder rights may differ from holding stocks directly, and should not automatically be deemed as enjoying shareholder status, voting rights, or other shareholder rights. The price of the relevant assets may also deviate from the underlying stock price. Specific rights and redemption arrangements are subject to the product terms.
- Third-party and technical risk: The product may involve issuers, custodians, and other service providers, whose operational, performance, or solvency issues may affect asset delivery, trading, or redemption. If a blockchain is involved, network congestion, smart contract vulnerabilities, or other technical failures may also cause delays or losses.
- Regulatory and geographical restrictions: The regulatory status and availability of the relevant products vary by jurisdiction, and regulatory changes may affect subscription, holding, trading, or redemption. Users should confirm that they meet the eligibility requirements and the legal and regulatory requirements of their location.
- Please fully understand before participating: This FAQ only outlines the main risks, does not constitute investment advice, and does not cover all risks. Please carefully read the risk warnings and product terms on the specific subscription page, and make decisions based on your own financial situation and risk tolerance.
Who can participate in the new user rewards? How to claim them?
The new user reward is only available to new Bitget users who register from November 2, 2026, 00:00 (UTC+8) and complete identity verification.
Make a first-time deposit of ≥ 1000 USDT and participate in the IPO subscription to claim the 20 USDT reward tier; make a first-time deposit of ≥ 30,000 USDT and participate in the subscription to claim the 100 USDT reward tier and an instant VIP upgrade. The two tiers cannot be stacked, and you can only receive one of them. The first-time deposit amount is calculated based solely on a single transaction and does not support multiple cumulative deposits. Users who meet the first-time deposit requirement via P2P can claim an additional 5 USDT bonus reward. Please see the activity rules below for details.

Headline: Binance Earn Launches BTC Yield APR Boost Promotion with Up to an Additional 2% APR for VIP Users
Prize pool: 70K USD
Start: 2026-11-17T03:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-16T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Earn is running a limited-time BTC Yield (BTCY) promotion, offering additional rewards for both new net subscriptions and existing holdings.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-17 03:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-16 23:59 (UTC)
During the Promotion Period, eligible VIP 1 to VIP 9 users may receive an additional APR Boost of up to 2% on new net subscriptions and 0.5% on existing holdings. Eligible Regular users may receive up to 1% on new net subscriptions and 0.25% on existing holdings.
## Reward Structure
User Type | Daily Average Newly Subscribed Holdings During the Promotion Period | Additional APR Boost
VIP 1 - VIP 9 users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings < 1 | 0.5%
1 ≤ Daily average holdings < 5 | 1%
5 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 2%
Regular users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings < 1 | 0.25%
1 ≤ Daily average holdings < 5 | 0.5%
5 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 1%
Existing holdings are determined by a snapshot taken on 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC).
User Type | Daily Average Existing Holdings During the Promotion Period | Additional APR Boost
VIP 1 - VIP 9 users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 0.5%
Regular users | 0.01 ≤ Daily average holdings ≤ 20 | 0.25%
## How to Participate
New net subscriptions: Users who make new net BTCY subscriptions on or after 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC) will be eligible for additional APR Boost rewards for new holdings during the Promotion Period.
Existing holdings: Users who hold BTCY at the snapshot taken on 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC) will be automatically enrolled. The BTCY balance recorded will be treated as the user’s existing holdings, and may receive the APR Boost.
Each user’s holdings will be split daily into existing and new holdings, as follows:
Daily Existing Holdings = The lower of (i) the user’s BTCY holdings on that day and (ii) the user’s snapshot balance.
Daily New Holdings = The user’s BTCY holdings on that day minus the user’s snapshot balance.
If the value is negative, it will be zero.
Note: Redeeming existing BTCY holdings and subsequently re-subscribing will not be considered new net subscriptions and will not qualify for additional rewards during the Promotion Period.
## How to Get Started
## App
Step 1: Tap [More] on the App homepage.
Step 2: Go to [Earn] > [BTC Yield].
Step 3: Tap [Subscribe] and enter the amount of BTC to commit.
Step 4: Read and agree to the terms and tap [Confirm].
Step 1: Navigate to the [Earn] section, select [Advanced Earn] and click [BTC Yield].
Step 2: Click [Subscribe] and enter the amount of BTC to commit.
Step 3: Read and agree to the terms and click [Confirm].
## Notes:
The total reward pool is equivalent to 70,000 USD in BTCY. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis until the reward pool is depleted. BTCY exchange rate is calculated based on the conversion rate announced the day the campaign ends.
The additional APR applies to eligible BTCY holdings from 0.01 BTCY to 20 BTCY. Users may receive APR Boost on up to 20 BTCY of new holdings and up to 20 BTCY of existing holdings.
For the portion exceeding 20 BTCY in either category, the additional APR does not apply. Only the native yield generated under the standard BTC Yield product rules will be earned.
Account Aggregation: Holdings of the master account and its sub-accounts will be aggregated for calculation and are subject to a single reward cap; sub-accounts are not eligible for a separate allocation.
The APR boost for each holdings tier applies to the entire holdings, not just the portion within that tier. For example, a VIP user with Daily Average New Holdings of 15 BTCY receives a 2% APR Boost on all 15 BTCY. The tier does not affect the APR Boost for existing holdings.
## VIP Reward Eligibility
To qualify for the additional 2% APR Boost Reward for new subscriptions or 0.5% for existing subscriptions, VIP users must continuously maintain their Binance VIP status at any tier, throughout all 30 Reward Calculation Days during the Promotion Period. If the user becomes a VIP after the Promotion has started or loses VIP status during the Promotion Period, they will not be eligible.
Binance will record each user’s VIP status daily at 00:00 (UTC). If a user does not meet the VIP eligibility requirement on any Reward Calculation Day, all rewards for the Promotion will be calculated using the Regular user APR Boost rate.
VIP status and VIP tier will be determined based on Binance’s system records.
## Reward Calculation:
Binance will record each user’s confirmed BTCY holdings daily at 00:00 (UTC) during the Promotion Period.
## Daily eligible holdings will be calculated as follows:
If a user’s BTCY holdings are below 0.01 BTCY on a given day, the eligible holdings for that day will be zero.
If a user’s BTCY holdings are equal to or greater than 0.01 BTCY, the actual holdings will be counted, subject to a maximum of 20 BTCY per day.
The average eligible holdings during the Promotion Period will be calculated as follows:
Daily Average Eligible Holdings = Sum of Daily Eligible Holdings for All 30 Reward Calculation Days / 30
VIP User APR Boost Reward for new net subscriptions: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × APR × 30) / 365
Regular User APR Boost Reward for new net subscriptions: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × APR × 30) / 365
VIP User APR Boost Reward for existing holdings: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × 0.50% × 30) / 365
Regular User APR Boost Reward for existing holdings: Reward = (Daily Average Eligible Holdings × 0.25% × 30) / 365.
## Case Example:
Please review examples for the total rewards for an eligible VIP user and a Regular user who has daily average newly subscribed holdings of 20 BTCY and holds 20 BTCY referring to snapshot taken on 2026-11-17 00:00 (UTC), during the entire Promotion Period.
 | VIP Users | Regular Users
Newly Subscribed Holdings (BTCY) | 20 | 20
Additional APR Boost | 2% | 1%
Additional Rewards (BTCY) | 0.0328767 | 0.0164384
Existing Holdings (BTCY) | 20 | 20
Additional APR Boost | 0.5% | 0.25%
Additional Rewards (BTCY) | 0.0082192 | 0.0041096
Total Rewards (BTCY) | 0.0410959 | 0.0205480
Final reward amounts will be subject to Binance’s system calculations.
## Reward Distribution
Rewards will be calculated based on daily holdings snapshots.
If the reward pool is fully depleted before the end of the Promotion Period, the accrual of APR Boost Rewards will end early.
Rewards will be automatically distributed to eligible users’ Spot Accounts on or before 2026-12-30 23:59 (UTC) after the Promotion Period ends.
Pending subscriptions and holdings for which redemption has been completed will not be included in the daily holdings snapshots.
## Guides and Related Materials
BTC Yield Product Page
Frequently Asked Questions on BTC Yield
BTC Yield Product Terms
## Terms and Conditions
Only users who complete identity verification and meet the aforementioned criteria during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotion. The products or features referred to above may not be available in your region. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Holdings of the master account and its sub-accounts shall be aggregated and subject to a single reward cap. Sub-accounts shall not be entitled to a separate allocation.
The BTC Yield Product Terms apply.
Disclaimer: Digital asset prices can be highly volatile. The value attributable to your BTCY strategy position may go down or up, and you may not receive back the amount of BTC you allocated. By participating in BTC Yield, you are converting your subscribed BTC to BTCY. BTC Yield is not capital protected, and you may lose some or all of your BTC. Any BTC Credits, APR, realised APR, illustrative yield, or similar figures shown in connection with BTCY are for information purposes only, are not guaranteed, may be zero, and refer to BTC-denominated amounts only rather than actual or predicted returns in fiat or any other digital asset such as BTC. BTC Yield uses a strategy that may underperform holding BTC directly, including in periods of strong BTC price appreciation. When you exit BTC Yield, the amount of BTC returned to you will depend on the applicable valuation at the relevant processing time, and this may be higher or lower than the valuation shown when you submitted your request. Fast Exit may be unavailable, and Standard Exit may be subject to processing windows, capacity limits, delays and fees. Binance does not provide financial, legal, tax or investment advice, and you are solely responsible for your investment decisions. For more information, please see the BTC Yield Product Terms, Terms of Use and Risk Warning.

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Wallet is excited to launch the KII Trading Competition on Binance Alpha! During the Promotion Periods, trade KiiChain (KII) in your Binance Wallet (Keyless) or via Binance Alpha to receive exclusive token rewards. Any user who is eligible to trade Binance Alpha tokens is eligible to participate in this trading competition.
1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-18 13:00 (UTC) to 2026-11-25 13:00 (UTC)
2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-25 13:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-02 13:00 (UTC)
## General Rules 
Participants will be ranked according to their total purchase volume on KII during the Promotion Period. The top 2,000 users by purchase volume of KII tokens during the Promotion Period will share 1,250,000 KII tokens equally (= 625 KII per user).
Rewards will now place greater emphasis on early trading and consistent participation during the Promotion Period, making reward distribution fairer, returns clearer, and participation more accessible. To support this, we are introducing the Early Bird Boost Multiplier.
To further encourage broader participation, we are also introducing the Rising Trader Boost Multiplier.
## Early Bird Boost Multiplier
Users can now trade earlier to earn more. In the Promotion Period, earlier trades will receive a higher multiplier, which boosts a user’s base trading volume.
## Daily Effective Trading Volume is calculated as follows:
Daily Effective Trading Volume = Actual Trading Volume * Early Bird Boost Multiplier
Note: Total trading volume for the competition is the sum of daily effective trading volume during the Promotion Period.
Users’ base trading volume generated during the following days in the Promotion Period will receive the corresponding multiplier when calculating their rankings:
Trading Day | Eligible Date and Time (UTC) | Multiplier
Day 1 | 1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-18 13:00 to 2026-11-19 13:00 and 2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-25 13:00 to 2026-11-26 13:00 | 2.0x
Day 2 | 1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-19 13:00 to 2026-11-20 13:00 and 2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-26 13:00 to 2026-11-27 13:00 | 2.0x
Day 3 | 1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-20 13:00 to 2026-11-21 13:00 and 2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-27 13:00 to 2026-11-28 13:00 | 1.8x
Day 4 | 1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-21 13:00 to 2026-11-22 13:00 and 2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-28 13:00 to 2026-11-29 13:00 | 1.8x
Day 5 | 1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-22 13:00 to 2026-11-23 13:00 and 2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-29 13:00 to 2026-11-30 13:00 | 1.5x
Day 6 | 1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-23 13:00 to 2026-11-24 13:00 and 2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-30 13:00 to 2026-12-01 13:00 | 1.3x
Day 7 | 1st KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-11-24 13:00 to 2026-11-25 13:00 and 2nd KII Trading Competition Promotion Period: 2026-12-01 13:00 to 2026-12-02 13:00 | 1.0x
## Rising Trader Boost Multiplier
For the purpose of this Promotion, “Rising Traders” refers to users who, as of three days before the start of the Promotion Period, have won any rewards in fewer than 3 previous Binance Wallet’s Alpha trading competitions.
Eligible Rising Traders will receive a 1.2x Rising Trader Boost on their actual trading volume during the Promotion Period, subject to a Rising Trader Boost Cap.
## Notes:
The "Rising Trader" qualification is determined as of three days before the activity period begins.
For example, if a user wins a trading competition ending on Day T, and their cumulative historical win count reaches exactly 3 at that point, they will still qualify as a Rising Trader for new competitions starting on T+1 and T+2 (since the qualification snapshot was taken before their 3rd win). However, for competitions starting on T+3 and beyond, their historical win count will already be 3 or more at the qualification snapshot, and they will no longer be eligible for the Rising Trader bonus.
The Rising Trader Boost Cap refers to the maximum actual trading volume that can receive the Rising Trader Boost during the Promotion Period. Once a user’s Rising Trader Boost Cap has been reached, the user will no longer receive Rising Trader Boosts for any subsequent trading volume.
If both the Early Bird Boost Multiplier and Rising Trader Boost apply, Effective Trading Volume will be calculated as follows:
Effective Trading Volume = Actual Trading Volume * Early Bird Boost Multiplier + min(Actual Trading Volume, Remaining Rising Trader Boost Cap) * Rising Trader Boost
The final ranking will be calculated based on users’ total Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period. A user’s total Effective Trading Volume is the sum of their daily Effective Trading Volume during the Promotion Period.
## Example:
User A generates 10,000 USDT in actual trading volume on Day 1. The Day 1 Early Bird Boost Multiplier is 2.0x, and User A is also eligible for the 1.2x Rising Trader Boost. The Rising Trader Boost Cap is 5,000 USDT.
User A's Day 1 Effective Trading Volume is calculated as follows:
Early Bird Boost: 10,000 * 2.0 = 20,000 USDT
Rising Trader Boost: User A's actual trading volume (10,000 USDT) exceeds the Rising Trader Boost Cap (5,000 USDT), so only 5,000 USDT is eligible for the Rising Trader Boost = 5,000 * 1.2 = 6,000 USDT
Day 1 Effective Trading Volume = 20,000 + 6,000 = 26,000 USDT
After Day 1, User A's 5,000 USDT Rising Trader Boost Cap has been fully used. Therefore, User A will no longer receive the Rising Trader Boost for any subsequent trading volume during the Promotion Period.
## Please Note:
Only trades executed via Binance Wallet (Keyless) or Binance Alpha on Binance Wallet will qualify in this Promotion. Third-party dApp transactions are excluded.
Only cumulative purchases count as trading volume for the purposes of the Promotion. Selling is excluded.
No Volume Caps : There is no cap on the trading volume for each participant in this Promotion.
Token bridging transactions are not eligible for this Promotion.
Effective from 2025-06-17 00:00 (UTC), trading volume generated from Alpha-to-Alpha token pairs will no longer be counted toward Alpha Points. Such trading volume will also be excluded from the Trading Competition and will not impact competition rankings.
## Reward Distribution:
All rewards will be calculated in accordance with the reward distribution rules above and will be claimable in KII tokens by eligible users.
Token rewards will be made available to eligible users before 2026-12-16 13:00:00 (UTC). Eligible users must complete the claim within 14 days after rewards become claimable. Any rewards not claimed within this period will be deemed forfeited and will not be reissued.
Eligible winners can view and claim their token rewards directly via their Binance Alpha accounts or Binance Wallet (Keyless).
## How to Participate
Click [Join] on the Binance App event page to participate in the promotion. Only trading volume generated after successfully clicking [Join] will be counted as valid trading volume for the competition.
Update your Binance App to the latest version, ensure you have created a Binance Wallet (Keyless) and backed it up.
During the Promotion Period, trade KII on Binance Wallet (Keyless) or Binance Alpha.
After the Promotion Period ends, rankings will be automatically calculated. Eligible winners can claim their rewards on the event page.
## Terms & Conditions
Only users who maintain an active Binance Account on the Binance Platform are eligible to participate in this Activity. Tokens will not be distributed to users who delete or deactivate their Binance Wallets and/or their Binance Accounts on the Binance Platform.
You may interact with Third-Party Services and DApps and through this Promotion. Third-Party Service Providers operate independently and may have different security standards, operational practices, and regulatory compliance. Binance Wallet does not control or guarantee the performance, security, or reliability of these Third-Parties. Users are responsible to conduct their own independent research to ensure the Third-Party Service is suitable for them.
Binance Wallet reserves the right to disqualify a user’s reward eligibility if Binance Wallet determines that the user has breached the Binance Wallet Terms of Use, tampered with Binance Wallet program code, or interfered with the operation of Binance Wallet program code with other software.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
